MULLEN & MULLEN INJURY LAW™
Learn what makes us stand out from the crowd.
**_When you join the Mullen & Mullen family, your case will be handled like family._**
Founded in 1983, Mullen & Mullen Law Firm is a family-owned boutique personal injury law firm with locations in Dallas, Plano, Frisco, Fort Worth, and St. Louis. We have proudly been in business in North Texas for 43 years. Since our inception, the goal has remained the same – **to handle your personal injury case the same way we would want our own handled**.
**In the past five years, we’ve made TopVerdict.com’s Texas Top Settlements lists 105 times.**
  * We Put $$ in Your Pocket or Waive Our Fees 
  * You Pay $0 Unless We Collect
  * It’s Been That Way Since 1983


**About Mullen & Mullen & What Makes Us Unique**
Mullen & Mullen is not a high-volume personal injury law firm that rushes clients through an assembly line. We don’t use paralegals to do the heavy lifting. Our lawyers give every client the individual attention they deserve. Your assigned attorney will oversee the management and development of your case from start to finish.
A substantial number of new clients every month are referred to us by former clients who are pleased with our legal services and trust us to help those close to them.
**Experience and Results**
Combined our attorneys have 104+ years of combined expertise in handling personal injury cases. Mullen & Mullen has represented thousands of clients who were bodily injured by third party recklessness or negligence and has obtained over $800 million in settlements.
**In the past five years, we’ve made TopVerdict’s Texas Personal Injury Settlements lists 105 times.**
**[Attorney Regis L. Mullen](https://www.mullenandmullen.com/about/regis-l-mullen-attorney/)** , Founder, began his career as an insurance adjuster gaining invaluable knowledge of how the insurance industry works. He has successfully practiced personal injury law for 59 years.
**[Attorney Shane V. Mullen](https://www.mullenandmullen.com/about/shane-v-mullen-attorney/)** , our Managing Partner, was recognized as a Texas Super Lawyer by Thomson Reuters three consecutive years. He is a member of both the Million and Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forums. Shane has been practicing law for 24 years.
**[Attorney Joseph R. Morrison](https://www.mullenandmullen.com/about/joseph-r-morrison-attorney/)** , Senior Associate, served as counsel of record in a top 5 recognized Texas premises liability jury verdict. He is a member of both the Million and Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forums. Joe has been practicing law for 21 years.
## Discounted 29% Pre-Suit Contingency Fee
The standard Texas personal injury attorney contingency fee is 33.3% – 35% of the gross settlement on cases that settle prior to the commencement of litigation. Some lawyers charge even more. We can offer our [discounted 29% fee](https://www.mullenandmullen.com/personal-injury-lawyer/free-consultation/) because we are confident in our ability to obtain excellent financial recoveries for our clients.
## Case Development & Quality
To us you are not just a number. We don’t pass your claim off to a paralegal. Instead, your attorney will be actively involved in working on your personal injury claim from start to finish.
## Financial Resources
**Mullen & Mullen has the financial resources to battle the insurance companies.** Before resorting to filing a lawsuit, we routinely retain experts and utilize our in-house accident investigators, to maximize your chances of obtaining an excellent settlement without going to court. If possible, you want to settle without litigation as it will save you a lot of time and legal fees. More time and more money in your pocket are always our goals. We will not hesitate to recommend litigation when it is necessary.
## Medical Diagnostics & Treatment With Delayed Billing
We help you get the medical treatment you need and deserve. Some doctors refuse to treat accident victims. Additionally, if you don’t have health insurance (OR) if paying co-pays and deductibles would be burdensome, upon request, we will refer you to a doctor near your home or office that will defer collecting payment until the conclusion of your case.
## We Level The Playing Field
We’re going to help you level the playing field and here’s how:
Regardless of how you were hurt, the actions you take and the decisions you make in the days, weeks, and months following a motor vehicle collision will make or break your case.
The insurance industry has already had the opportunity to plan for and strategize how to deal with your claim before you even got hurt. They are a business focused on earning money, not paying you what you deserve or what is fair.
We will immediately send one of our firm’s in-house investigators to meet with you at your home or office. After meeting with you, our investigator will begin establishing fault on the other party. This generally includes ordering your police report, taking photographs and/or video footage of vehicles as well as the scene, interviewing and obtaining affidavits from witnesses, running public records searches, and utilizing the Freedom of Information Act.
We’re going to make sure your vehicle is repaired or replaced quickly.
We’re going to make sure you have a rental vehicle while your car is being repaired.
Recovering lost wages and loss of earning capacity in the future can be tricky, difficult, and may require our firm advancing the money to hire an expert such as a Vocational Rehabilitation Consultant and/or Economist.
If your car accident has caused serious financial stress, we will immediately attempt to secure you relief through a law loan and/or through first party insurance coverage.
Your attorney will immediately send a demand to preserve evidence so that responsible parties do not tamper with or destroy evidence in your favor.
We can help you get all necessary medical attention. If you do not have health insurance or the high cost of co-pays and deductibles is burdensome, we will – upon request – help you find a doctor near your home or work that will defer payment till your case is over. Mullen & Mullen Law Firm has established relationships over the past three decades with medical doctors, surgeons, neurologists, chiropractors, physical therapists, diagnostic facilities, and pharmacies across the State of Texas. These healthcare providers all defer payment and have extensive experience helping victims of car accidents recover from their injuries.
Your personal injury case will get the full attention it deserves. You won’t be cattle-farmed along a big law firm assembly line. Our firm does not employ a single paralegal. You will have an actual attorney or former insurance claims adjuster that will handle your case from start to finish – monitoring the progress of your case through all steps of the process. Any advice you are given will be custom-tailored to your specific case.
We will skillfully negotiate to the best of our ability a fair settlement. We insist you recover every dollar you are entitled to.

In the last four years, our firm made Top Verdict’s “Top 50” Personal Injury Settlements in Texas list 44 times, and the “Top 100” list 70 times.
## Why Choose Mullen & Mullen to Handle Your Case?
Consistently Recognized for Top Settlements
According to TopVerdict.com, our attorneys consistently achieve some of the highest recoveries in the state. As a matter of fact, in the last five years, we’ve made their Texas “Top” lists 105 times. We also placed on their #1 settlements list for Dallas county (in different categories) 9 times. (2025 lists not yet published). When you factor in our reduced [29% contingency fee](https://www.mullenandmullen.com/personal-injury-lawyer/free-consultation/), we are confident we will help you recover more. At Mullen & Mullen, we pride ourselves on routinely recovering full policy limits for our clients without the necessity of costly and time-consuming litigation.
Medical Diagnostics & Treatment with Delayed Billing
We have access to state-of-the-art diagnostic technology through well-established relationships with medical doctors, surgeons, physical therapists, chiropractors, neurologists, counselors, and other healthcare providers in the entire DFW Metroplex. You receive the quality medical attention you need from local providers near where you live or work. These providers specialize in treating people hurt in accidents of all kinds and they know how to properly document injuries to meet the legal burden of proof in your personal injury case. These providers are also willing to delay billing collections until after your case is resolved so you can focus on recovering without additional stress. Physicians that don’t routinely treat accident victims as part of their practice usually turn away patients over fear of being involved in the legal process or fear of health insurance companies refusing to pay accident-related healthcare bills. Please call us at 214-747-5240 for a free consultation and some advice.
We Can Help Even if You Don't Have Health Insurance
Even if you don’t have health insurance or can’t afford your deductible, Mullen & Mullen will secure you the quality healthcare and state-of-the art diagnostics you deserve with no upfront out of pocket costs.
Leverage Our More Than 100 Years Combined Experience
Shane, Joseph and Regis have 104 years of combined experience practicing personal injury law. That doesn’t even include the combined experience of the attorneys that serve as of-counsel to Mullen & Mullen at no additional cost to our clients. Our firm continues to evolve, but we never forget our Core Values. We do the right thing, handle cases the way we would want our own case handled, and we truly listen to clients. We have over 40 years of local knowledge, and that matters!
Work Directly With Your Attorney
Some lawyers forget that they represent the client, but we never have. Our legal team will make YOU the priority. You are the boss, and we will respond quickly to your requests for case updates and assistance. We guarantee that when you need to speak to your counsel, you will speak directly to your counsel, not to a paralegal or secretary, because that’s the way it should be.
In-House Accident Investigators at No Cost to You
Most firms hire an investigator to help develop evidence on your case and charge you back for that service. Our firm, however, has 2 full-time accident investigators on staff and we offer their services to you for free. This is another way we will maximize your compensation.
In-House Videographer at No Cost to You
They say a picture is worth a thousand words. Video footage is worth a lot more. Our in-house videographer allows us to capture the true impact the accident has on your life beyond mere words on a piece of paper.
We Fully Develop Cases and Stay Ahead of The Curve
When necessary, Mullen & Mullen Law Firm uses cutting edge technology like 3D imaging videos to fully demonstrate the extent of our clients’ injuries to the insurance companies. This also helps maximize the value of your claim.
This is Our Backyard™
Mullen & Mullen’s attorneys live and work right here in Dallas, and always have. We believe in paying our success forward by helping people in the North Texas community, and are dedicated to supporting these local [charities](https://www.mullenandmullen.com/charities/).
More Than Just Legal Representation
Mullen & Mullen:
  * Connects you with top medical experts so you recover as fast and fully as possible (and so you have the strongest evidence supporting your case).
  * Helps you best navigate any medical bills you’ve already accrued so you can keep billers and collectors at bay while your case is pending.
  * Deals with insurers so you don’t make a mistake and find yourself cheated out of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of dollars.
  * Allows you to focus on working through the physical and emotional trauma of your accident.


The Mullen & Mullen Way
###  Success 
Our success rate speaks for itself. We consistently earn awards from TopVerdict.com for achieving the highest settlement amounts in Texas. In fact, no other law office made their 2021 Texas "Top 50" personal injury settlements list as many times as we did. We placed on it nineteen times in a single year. 
###  Responsiveness 
You'll always be kept in the loop regarding the status of your case. Calls are answered promptly, and you can even text your dedicated legal team directly 24/7. 
###  Caring 
We'll make you feel like part of the family, not just another case. Our compassionate lawyers will take the time to listen to your story, comprehensively understand your unique circumstances, and we will tailor our legal strategies accordingly. Your best interests are at the forefront of everything we do. 
###  Local 
Mullen & Mullen has been a mainstay in the North Texas community since 1983. Our attorneys are always willing to meet with injury victims face-to-face. You won’t be dealing with some call center hundreds of miles away or on the other side of the country (or world). 
###  Aggressive 
We won’t back down or be intimidated in any form or fashion. We will not allow insurance carriers to delay, deny, or minimize your claim. We never hesitate to recommend litigation if it is necessary to achieve a just outcome. 
###  Attorney Access 
When you work with a big law firm, you'll most likely be assigned a case worker and may never even talk to your attorney. Our attorneys make themselves available and invest in your case personally. 
###  Discounted Contingency Fee 
Of course we only get paid when you do. And when we do, we discount our legal fees to 29% instead of the industry standard 33.3% for claims that settle without litigation. 
###  Top Reviewed 
It's not just the hundreds of 5-star reviews that we've earned, but the things that our clients say. Read our reviews and you'll quickly see that we put passion into our work. 
[ Read our reviews > ](https://www.mullenandmullen.com/about/)
Ready to Get Started?
The Mullen & Mullen family is here to address your concerns and make the path to recovery smooth. There are no fees to get started and you pay $0 if we don’t settle your case.
